purpose: Recover the preregistered ten-block statistics from the immutable 90-case V9 source after its frozen V2-case/V1-analyzer interface failure, and audit both stale graph-backtrack re-anchoring and repeated frontier/exit-stub lifecycle behavior across all 30 V9 cases.

approval.scope: One immutable read-only audit of the exact finalized 90-case source; no simulation, bag read, training, model selection or source mutation.
approval.confirmation_reference: The user granted autonomous execution for the fixed paper scope without repeated approvals; final execution remains conditional on exact source state, summary, schedule and seal binding.

method.statistics: Deep-copy the 90 sealed summaries, map only PASS_SINGLE_ROBOT_CASE_V2 to the V1 analyzer status in memory, and invoke the frozen preregistered ten-block analyzer.
method.mechanism: Verify all 60 V9 trace/snapshot files against the source seal and compute exact stale-arrival proxy, route-arc growth, tail stagnation, repeated frontier selection, graph-update reasons, final exit-stub counts, travel, coverage and fallback evidence per case.

failure_policy: Fail on source state/status/count/seal/schedule-file/schedule-content drift, missing or non-finite case evidence, non-PASS recording/storage/planner contract, trace/snapshot hash drift, non-contiguous frames, invalid route arc, any source write, raw bag read, C09/C10 read or training activity.
expected_evidence: 90-case source manifest and verified source provenance
30-case V9 re-anchor and frontier-lifecycle mechanism audit with 60 verified trace/snapshot hashes

estimated_cost.compute: Read-only CPU JSON audit; zero Gazebo, ROS, GPU, training or raw bag decompression.
